events.title: Moroni Visits Joseph Smith
events.blurb: Three times in one night, then again at dawn, the resurrected Moroni quotes Malachi anew: Elijah will plant the promises in the children's hearts.

events.title: Joseph Receives the Plates
events.blurb: After four years of annual visits to the hill, Moroni entrusts the golden record to a 21-year-old with a strict charge to keep it safe.

events.title: The 116 Pages Are Lost
events.blurb: Martin Harris loses the manuscript, and Joseph learns the lesson of the Restoration: 'the works, and the designs... of God cannot be frustrated' — but men can lose their gift.

events.title: John the Baptist Restores the Priesthood
events.blurb: On the banks of the Susquehanna, a resurrected messenger lays hands on Joseph and Oliver: 'Upon you my fellow servants... I confer the Priesthood of Aaron.'

events.title: Three Witnesses See the Plates
events.blurb: An angel shows the plates to Oliver, David, and Martin, and a voice from heaven declares the translation true — 'by the mouth of two or three witnesses.'

events.title: The Church Is Organized
events.blurb: In the Whitmer farmhouse at Fayette, about sixty souls witness the church of Christ organized 'agreeable to the laws of our country' — six elders, bread, water, and the Spirit poured out.

events.title: The Call to Gather at Kirtland
events.blurb: 'Go to the Ohio' — the first gathering of the last days begins, with a promise: 'there I will give unto you my law; and there you shall be endowed with power from on high.'

events.title: The Law of the Church
events.blurb: The promised law arrives at Kirtland: teach the scriptures, live the commandments, and consecrate for the poor — 'remember in all things the poor and the needy.'

events.title: Zion Designated at Independence
events.blurb: On the Missouri frontier the word comes: 'this is the land of promise, and the place for the city of Zion' — with the temple lot 'not far from the courthouse.'

events.title: The Vision of the Degrees of Glory
events.blurb: While translating John 5, Joseph and Sidney see the Son on the right hand of God and three kingdoms of glory — 'And this is the gospel... he saves all the works of his hands.'

events.title: The Word of Wisdom
events.blurb: Prompted by tobacco smoke in the School of the Prophets, a 'principle with promise' arrives: health, wisdom, treasures of knowledge, and running without weariness.

events.title: Vision of the Celestial Kingdom
events.blurb: In the unfinished temple Joseph sees the blazing throne of God — and his brother Alvin, who died unbaptized: all who would have received the gospel 'shall be heirs of the celestial kingdom.'

events.title: The Kirtland Temple Dedicated
events.blurb: The first temple of the Restoration is offered back to the Lord: 'that thy glory may rest down upon thy people' — a day of pentecostal outpouring the Saints never forgot.

events.title: The Savior, Moses, Elias & Elijah Appear
events.blurb: Behind the veils of the temple pulpits, the Lord accepts His house — then Moses, Elias, and Elijah commit the keys of gathering, the gospel of Abraham, and the sealing power.

events.title: Liberty Jail
events.blurb: From a dungeon called Liberty, the prisoner's cry — 'O God, where art thou?' — is answered with the Restoration's tenderest words: 'thine adversity... shall be but a small moment.'

events.title: Nauvoo & Baptism for the Dead
events.blurb: On the Mississippi bend the Saints are commanded to build a temple with a font, 'for a baptismal font there is not upon the earth' — the dead are not beyond the gospel's reach.

events.title: Instructions at Ramus
events.blurb: Fireside doctrine in a small prairie town: the Father and Son have bodies of flesh and bone, and 'that same sociality which exists among us here will exist among us there.'

events.title: The Martyrdom at Carthage
events.blurb: 'I am going like a lamb to the slaughter.' A mob with painted faces storms the jail; Joseph and Hyrum seal their testimony with their blood, and John Taylor survives to record it.

events.title: The Camp of Israel at Winter Quarters
events.blurb: On the Missouri's west bank, the word and will of the Lord organizes the exodus: companies with captains, covenants to care for the widow and orphan, and songs on the way west.

events.title: Vision of the Redemption of the Dead
events.blurb: Pondering Peter amid a world war and pandemic, President Joseph F. Smith sees the Savior organize His forces in the spirit world — the gospel preached to those who died without it.
